name: dsh-bloom-theme
description: Bloom for DSH — 玻璃+莫兰迪主题。15 套 OKLCH 配色（新增轻黄；主菜单精选 12 套，赤橙黄绿青蓝紫齐全，旧配色兼容），明暗自适应；磨砂玻璃面板默认常开；微动效 + 版本/更新指示。零依赖、TypeScript、WCAG AA。

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run build:watch
scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/dsh-drift.mjs && ui-craft && node --test scripts/version.test.mjs && node --test scripts/persistence.test.mjs && node --test test/stale-package-name.test.mjs test/readme-package-name.test.mjs test/enrich-release.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/prepublish-gate.mjs && node scripts/readme-gate.mjs && node scripts/version-sync-gate.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node --test test/lifecycle.test.mjs test/i18n.test.mjs test/rotation.test.mjs test/palette-distinctness.test.mjs test/surface-regression.test.mjs test/update-install.test.mjs test/typing-telemetry.test.mjs test/adaptive-glass.test.mjs test/appearance-host-theme.test.mjs test/starlight.test.mjs test/liquid-layout.test.mjs test/liquid-lens.test.mjs test/inspect.test.mjs test/material-persistence.test.mjs test/diagnostics.test.mjs test/background-contrast.test.mjs test/fog.test.mjs test/button-bead.test.mjs test/surfaces-glass.test.mjs test/footer-layout.test.mjs test/share-capture.test.mjs test/share-ui.test.mjs test/feedback.test.mjs test/ambience-persistence.test.mjs test/meteor-color-mode.test.mjs test/dark-glow-continuity.test.mjs test/sidebar-clearance.test.mjs
